== Status

This review is evidence of an independent reconstruction of program state from repository contents and Git metadata. It is not an authoritative program-control baseline, implementation decision, or replacement for live repository reconciliation.

== Purpose of admission

The purpose of admitting this review is to preserve an independent reading of the repositories at the close of the MCP recovery/hardening diversion and before resuming the KIOS/Omelas consolidation path.

The review is useful because it tests whether a reviewer without access to the working conversation can reconstruct the program state from committed repository evidence.

The preserved prompt makes that reconstruction more auditable by recording the instructions supplied to the reviewer.

== Observations supported by the review

The external review independently reconstructed the following major control boundaries consistently with the repositories:

* `awake-in-omelas` contains the canonical Omelas/KIOS/domain material and associated governance/evidence.
* `governed-mcp-runtime` owns the governed MCP/MCPO runtime implementation, dependency pinning, image-selection behavior, runtime governance, and validation tests.
* `awake-in-omelas-program-control` is a control repository rather than an implementation repository.
* Recovery, runtime hardening, consolidation, and architectural refactoring are distinct control stages and should not be collapsed together.
* MCP recovery/hardening established pinned dependencies, immutable runtime image selection, and a successful four-phase authenticated GHCR recovery validation.
* The runtime hardening work cleared the immediate MCP recovery/artifact-durability blockers without performing KIOS/Omelas consolidation or architectural extraction.
* The next program-control activity remains the reconciliation and integration/parking-baseline sequence before architectural separation begins.

== Qualifications and corrections

The review is advisory and contains several points that must not be promoted directly into authoritative control state without qualification.

=== Repository name in summary graphic

The summary graphic labels the runtime repository as `mcp-runtime`.

The canonical repository name is:

----
governed-mcp-runtime
----

The abbreviated graphic label should not be used as the repository identifier in program-control decisions or execution instructions.

=== Branch SHAs and ahead/behind counts

The review reports the recorded program-control checkpoint values for `development` and `feature/openwebui-mcp-filesystem`, including the historical `0 49` ahead/behind relationship.

Those values are evidence of the recorded checkpoint, not proof of current live Git state on admission of this review.

Live repository state must be reconciled before any integration action is taken.

=== Integration method remains a decision

The summary graphic states the next checkpoint as merging `feature/openwebui-mcp-filesystem` into `development`.

The supporting repository evidence is more precise: merge is the preferred integration method absent a concrete reason otherwise, but the integration method remains a pending decision until it is explicitly selected and recorded after live-state reconciliation.

The control-safe sequence therefore remains:

. reconcile live Git state
. decide and record the integration method
. perform the integration
. validate the resulting `development` state
. record the validated `development` parking baseline
. only then begin the next architectural separation phase

== Authority boundary

The authoritative sources remain:

* committed repository contents
* committed tests and validation evidence
* admitted program-control baselines and decisions
* live Git state when an execution decision depends on current repository state

This external review may inform analysis and expose ambiguity, but it does not supersede those sources.

The preserved prompt is provenance for the review process. It is not itself an implementation decision or program-control baseline.

== Admission result

The Claude review is admitted as external advisory evidence because it successfully reconstructs the major repository responsibilities, MCP recovery/hardening sequence, GHCR recovery validation, deferred work, and the intended consolidation control sequence from repository evidence alone.

Its value is specifically as an independent reconstruction and documentation-quality check.

The prompt used to request that reconstruction is admitted alongside the review so the analysis can later be interpreted in the context of the instructions given to the reviewer.

No consolidation integration decision is admitted by this review.
No branch SHA or ahead/behind value is refreshed by this review.
No architectural refactoring is authorized by this review.

== Next control step

After this review artifact and its prompt provenance are admitted, resume the previously planned consolidation control path:

. reconcile live state for `awake-in-omelas` and `awake-in-omelas-program-control`
. verify the current relationship between `development` and `feature/openwebui-mcp-filesystem`
. decide and record the integration method
. establish and validate the `development` parking baseline

Do not begin extraction or architectural separation before that parking baseline is admitted.
